title: The SAR team's first international conference in Malta

tellings.quote: um the organizers of the SAR team's first international conference was in Malta back in June of 2025, and the organizers of the conference were familiar with my work.

plain: In June 2025, the team using SAR, a satellite radar that can image what lies beneath the ground, held its first international conference in Malta, according to a researcher named Jeffrey Drum. Drum tells Michels he was involved because the organizers "were familiar with my work", and he links the team to a researcher named Filippo Biondi and a man named Armando. He brings it up as part of their claim that radar shows a large energy system under the pyramids of Egypt.
